updates.contributionWorkflow: Direct or paused? Customize your trusted end-user audience contributions
updates.contributionWorkflowDescription: Your chatbot can take in contributions from trusted members of your audience. That new knowledge can now be added directly and used automatically by your chatbot to respond to other end-users. Or you can choose to have their contributions start off as paused.
updates.contributionWorkflowDescriptionC: With contributions starting off paused, it gives you the opportunity to review and approve, or have that content inform new documents you add to your data sources, you’re in control.
updates.importantDescription: Your chatbot can give extra weight or importance to items and documents from your data sources. Look for the {icon} icon and mark them as important.
updates.languagePersonalizationAvailable: Available languages: English, العربية, Español, Français, हिन्दी, Português
updates.languagePersonalizationDescripti: Do you want your chatbot to only respond in select languages? Set the list of languages your chatbot will respond in by setting a new personalization.
updates.newResources: Speak with a person and product and services support
updates.newResourcesDescription: Are there times when your audience needs to reach a representative from your organization? Do you have products or services that you want your audience to be aware of?
updates.newResourcesDescriptionContinued: When the system detects your audience needs to speak to a person, or they are interested in your products and services, you can add a link, email address, or phone number and it will be included in your chatbot’s response.
updates.updateContributions: Tips, reports, ideas, and knowledge from anyone in your audience
updates.updateContributionsDescription: Go beyond the trusted end-user contributions workflow by allowing community contributions from anyone in your audience.
updates.updateContributionsDescriptionCo: People can share news tips, local observations, or early warnings as soon as they notice them. Share your contribution code and start to learn from your audience.
updates.updateGoogleDrive: Connecting Suwali to your Google Drive — simplified
updates.updateGoogleDriveDescription: It’s now simpler to connect Suwali to a Google Drive folder and have it stay in sync. You authenticate with your Google Drive account and select the first batch of files to add to your Suwali folder.
updates.updateGoogleDriveDescriptionCont: After that, you can manage all the files you want in Suwali directly from Google Drive, just update your Suwali folder and the files will be kept in sync automatically.
updates.updateWordpress: Connect your WordPress site to Suwali
updates.updateWordpressDescription: You can now add a WordPress site as a data source. Enter your site’s address, confirm that you manage it, and choose whether to import your posts or your pages.
updates.updateWordpressDescriptionContin: Suwali reads your published content through the WordPress REST API and keeps it up to date as you publish new articles.
updates.uploadDescription: Have a few documents you want your chatbot to use for responding to your audience? You can now include them by adding a new uploaded files data source. Supported files are the same as the Google Drive data source option, but with the flexibility of adding up to 5 files at a time.
updates.welcomePersonalizationDescriptio: You can now add a link, email address, or phone number to be included in the first message sent back to your audience. Use this resource to provide resources to your audience outside of your chatbot.
